sections.text: Tell us who can confirm the inspection is complete and authorize the next step. We will use that status before installing temporary protection. A scheduled appointment alone will not be treated as permission to alter the opening afterward without confirmation.

sections.title: Review attachment after the area is available
sections.text: The surrounding material may still need qualified preparation or structural evaluation. We will explain any limitation before installation proceeds. Temporary closure is not a determination that the whole wall or building is sound.

sections.title: Leave the next contractor a clear record
sections.text: We will document the opening addressed and any remaining exposure or access arrangement. Permanent replacement and weatherproofing remain separate. The handoff will describe temporary limits without promising protection against every future event.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/campbell.estimate: Share safe exterior photographs and the pending inspection requirements. The estimate will identify staging, opening conditions, and prerequisites. Response availability will be kept separate from the release-dependent completion step.
checklist: Identify who still needs access to the opening.
Confirm when work is released after inspection.
Share the permanent replacement plan if available.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/campbell.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Campbell helps when photographs show affected material beneath one room but the pipe repair occurred in another section. The relationship between those locations needs assessment before a broad scope is assumed. We will inspect safe accessible findings and explain the evaluated boundary.

sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup from more than one reported area
sections.text: We will organize the available observations by location before assuming they describe one continuous exposure. A pipe repair photograph and a material photograph may show different sections. The assessment will establish what is directly evaluated and where the connection between reports remains uncertain.

sections.title: Use practical location references
sections.text: Room names above, entry points, or notes from the original provider can help locate the concern. You do not need to enter contaminated space to recreate the route. We will document the references available during our safe access.

sections.title: Describe material actions by section
sections.text: Affected debris, coverings, insulation, and retained surfaces may need different decisions in each area. We will explain removal or treatment supported by findings and review new work before the boundary expands. The plumbing correction remains a separate source task.

sections.title: Handoff a location-based completion record
sections.text: We will identify areas addressed and remaining moisture, repair, or access concerns. Uninspected sections will remain explicit. A completed stage in one location will not be presented as approval of every section beneath the property.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/campbell.estimate: Share the plumbing report and any location notes accompanying the photographs. The quote will explain evaluated areas, material actions, and provisional assumptions. Replacement work should follow that specific record rather than a general statement that cleanup occurred.
checklist: Identify the room above each reported finding if known.
Share the source correction status.
Tell us which materials were already removed.
